ProjectionRace.scope: The existing editable-page replacement refusal and human-adoption ownership boundary, versus a rejected read-check-unconditional-replace proposal. Changed-body restore-follow calls the guard; automatic source-run policy also refuses unsupported projection replacement. A safe terminal refusal is not successful automatic update progress.
excluded: Provider revision-CAS
atomic old-string matching
enforced UI edit exclusion
multi-page API transactions
Explicit manual authoring writer protocol and all-writer guard coverage

UpdateCommit.scope: A bounded abstraction of one already-authorized selection write, two exact resource identities, two selected revisions and one existing session. Complete preparation precedes selection; an unknown original outcome cannot be invented from current equality. This is not a refinement proof of all source coordinator dispatches or a transaction across selection and readable projection.
excluded: Multiple writers or processes with different Stores
credential rotation
provider permission propagation
automatic Notion projection writes
arbitrary Git filesystem semantics
Source batch and periodic-run scheduling
Fixed-manifest storage codec, byte limits, canonical payload-cache behavior and immutable Record reconciliation

AuditRun.scope: Two surviving Skill roots, one orphan visible to the reverse census, one changed body, a one-Skill slice budget and up to two resumptions. The implemented coordinator performs initial/final registered-table census, durable task progress and a read-only semantic boundary; this finite model abstracts those operations and does not prove their HTTP accounting, SQLite durability or complete real-library coverage.
excluded: Arbitrary concurrent table changes or a global database snapshot
HTTP pagination and request/byte/deadline accounting
Endpoint and credential scope fences
SQLite crash atomicity
Durable scheduler availability
Automatic repair
Unknown historical data absent from every retained index

implemented_boundary.scope: The read-only transport restricts descendant helpers, including legacy Notion requests, before scheduling. The real-code mutation gate removes this guard around an otherwise auto-adopting observer and requires the independent zero-write assertion to fail.

ImportCreate.scope: One explicitly enabled original create, two complete input objects and four abstract mutable stages: root allocation, Files/resources, metadata/selection and enablement. Preparation freezes approved bytes, the first dispatch rechecks the original local input, stage confirmation requires its durable original ACK, and explicit enablement follows complete verification. Lost-response absence cannot authorize replay; an acknowledged interrupted readback can be reconciled. This remains the original create execution/reconciliation abstraction; the separately reviewed acknowledged-prefix recovery protocol is excluded.
excluded: Disabled creation
Arbitrary file counts, chunking, Markdown projection versions including v9 creation spacing and v10 literal/fence serialization, Record compression and logical/wire byte limits
C1/N1/C2 classification and provider/member acquisition
Concurrent human editing or a filesystem transaction during dispatch
Immutable content-addressed Record reconciliation
Credential rotation, distributed writers or global exactly-once delivery
The separately reviewed v1/v8 and v1/v9 prefix/known-failure recovery protocols; CreateRecovery has its own bounded mapping
Versioned prefix recovery completion, pending-create suppression and cold history/read reconstruction

CreateRecovery.scope: A v1/v9 recovery with one original main ACK and no original terminal, or three original native ACKs and a retained needs_review terminal; one abstract missing suffix and three mutable stages. Review/apply require the complete original evidence. An uncertain intermediate recovery never redispatches or advances through reconciliation. Exact Projection metadata authority must be checked before transport, with all initial files/events verified before enablement. The two operation histories and original native pages remain separate.
excluded: Actual 76-dispatch and 35-native/407-effective-file cardinality
Request/ACK serialization, cryptographic hashes, gzip, rich-text framing and SQLite durability
Markdown v9/v10 rendering, retained wire bytes and compact full-response observations
Cold completion and arbitrary consumer/history reconstruction
Concurrent edits after a stage's current observation, distributed writers and provider CAS
The historical v8-to-v9 recovery variant and original create/reconcile transitions
Arbitrary suffixes, immutable Record dispatch/reconciliation and all-writer authorization

AcknowledgedContinuation.scope: Three already visible native allocations with an independently variable original ACK subset and exact-request-set predicate. The separate continuation requires the complete original request/ACK authority at review and apply, a fresh current-body check before each abstract stage, no uncertain redispatch, complete initial events before enablement and complete retained original ACK proofs before a cold result is accepted. Four stages abstract ACK fact retention, exact metadata/events, enablement and immutable completion; original pages and needs_review history remain separate.
excluded: Actual 34/35 native and 397/407 full-file cardinality
Exact frozen request/response JSON, cryptographic hashes, ordinary 64 KiB envelopes and rich-text transport
Markdown v11 rendering, complete source acquisition and retained-policy compatibility
Edits occurring after a stage observation, distributed writers, provider CAS and atomic multi-page writes
Every immutable Record subrequest, current native-page allocation or general interrupted-stage restart
The direct original v10-to-v11 recovery branch, earlier recovery variants and public CLI/SDK behavior

review_basis: Exact implementation commit and content hashes reviewed for the stated bounded abstractions. Hash equality binds a model review to these source files; it is not a full refinement proof. Public CLI, installed SDK, real providers, Notion, human UI edits and both physical hosts require their independent evidence. A model pass does not establish AH-681 completion. The files map also includes the explicitly named unmodeled_bindings as reviewed context; hash verification of those files does not extend any model, invariant, bound or liveness claim.

unmodeled_bindings.name: fixed_manifest_storage
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The logical envelope identity stays separate from physical storage. The lifecycle models do not model gzip/Base64, logical or wire byte limits, arbitrary manifest cardinality, rich-text transport, cache representation or immutable Record reconciliation. These hashes bind the reviewed implementation context only.

unmodeled_bindings.name: native_projection_versions
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Projection versions, literal-token escaping, top-level creation paragraph/fence spacing, preserved submitted wire bytes and actual Notion rendering remain outside every model. ImportCreate treats the frozen candidate/readback as abstract values; CreateRecovery fixes the v9-to-v10 decision without proving its bytes. ProjectionRace still concerns refusal of unsafe existing-body replacement. Explicit old policies remain fixed. Policy 11 handles observed literal escaping in parsed top-level heading text; the retained version 1-10 policies and creation wire remain unchanged. Exact supporting YAML retention is separately bound below.

unmodeled_bindings.name: creation_recovery_payload_and_cold_completion
unmodeled_bindings.scope: The historical v1/v8 main-ACK-before-manifest protocol remains unmodeled. CreateRecovery models only the explicit bounded state/authority mapping for the v9 known-failure or sole-main branch. Full journal/dispatch/ACK content validation, exact Source and native metadata, compact observations, versioned v3/v4 payloads, complete retained objects, cold completion and pending-create suppression remain hash-bound reviewed context, not a consumer refinement proof. ACK and recovery proof schemas are leaf data dependencies; ESM initialization order requires real fresh Node checks and is not established by TLC.

unmodeled_bindings.name: complete_native_headers_and_restore_projection
unmodeled_bindings.scope: Complete input and retained header serialization are outside the finite models. New file-add v2 retains the exact original supporting header and input; source creation v11 retains C1 and N1 header/mode ancestry. Explicit write/apply check fresh consumer headers against retained native ownership before dispatch. Restore-follow v11 uses the native creation projection, but an unequal body still reaches the unchanged requireSafeBodyReplacement guard. No existing-body overwrite authority, unknown-write replay or ownership transition was added. ProjectionRace retains its original assumptions; old plan identities and unprojected plans remain accepted by their original contracts. The consumer and authoring paths both recognize .md and .markdown, so an explicit edit restores same-owner relative references to their exact bound native pages. This byte-level round trip remains outside the finite models.

unmodeled_bindings.name: source_batch_sqlite_checkpoints
unmodeled_bindings.scope: SQLite address registration and checkpoint persistence are outside UpdateCommit and AuditRun. Only exact operations/shared-source-batches/<scope SHA>/source-batch-<plan SHA>/<run UUID>.json addresses become mutable run checkpoints; original source member dispatch, ACK and selection facts remain immutable. Retired runs cannot be reopened. Real Node processes test dry/apply/reconcile with one original batch and independent run records; memory Store fixtures do not establish durability.

unmodeled_bindings.name: compact_native_ack_proofs_and_v11_recovery
unmodeled_bindings.scope: New review v4/outcome v5 handles an original v10 known fixed-Git failure. Continuation review v2/outcome v6 applies only to an exact known v3/v10 recovery whose entire native allocation set has durable original ACKs before metadata/events/enablement. Compact file commitments are independently reconstructed from the full retained original plan and explicit v11 policy, including all native metadata/events. Separate ordinary bounded object Records retain each full frozen POST and original ACK; immutable response hashes alone do not establish cold authority. The model abstracts the complete-set and cold-proof predicates but does not prove byte serialization, field schemas, real cardinality, SQLite, ESM startup or every consumer. Old review/outcome meanings remain fixed.
